title: Beaver's Jumping Track (Easy Version)
titleZh: 海狸的跳跃赛道（简单版）
statementMd:
**This is the easy version of the problem. The difference between the versions is that in this version, the constraint on $x$ and time limit are lower. You can hack only if you solved all versions of this problem.**

The Beaver is training to jump long distances. The Beaver can already jump $x$ meters. However, just jumping as far as possible is easy and boring. Therefore, the Beaver has created an unusual training track for jumping.

The track consists of $n$ platforms; each platform consists of $d_i$ meter cells. If the Beaver stands on platform number $i$, jumps, and lands back on the same platform, this results in $s_i$ penalty points being awarded; otherwise, no penalty points are given. The Beaver can jump forward any integer number of cells less than or equal to $x$. Note that the Beaver can skip one or more platforms in a single jump without landing on them at all.

The Beaver has unlimited computational power in its mind and always jumps in such a way as to minimize the total penalty for passing the track. Moreover, the track is not constant, and sometimes the lengths and penalties of some platforms change. Learn to calculate what penalty the Beaver will get if it starts standing on the first cell of platform number $l$ and finishes standing on the last cell of platform number $r$.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $n$, $q$, $x$ — the number of sections of the track, the number of queries, and the maximum jump length, respectively ($1 \leq n \leq 10^6$; $1 \leq q \leq 10^4$; $1 \leq x \leq 5$).

The second line contains $n$ integers $d_i$ — the lengths of the platforms ($1 \leq d_i \leq 10^7$).

The third line contains $n$ integers $s_i$ — the penalties ($1 \leq s_i \leq 10^5$).

The following $q$ lines describe the queries in one of the following formats:

1. "`1 $i$ $v$`" — set the length of the $i$-th platform to $v$ ($1 \leq i \leq n$; $1 \leq v \leq 10^7$);
2. "`2 $i$ $y$`" — set the penalty on the $i$-th platform to $y$ ($1 \leq i \leq n$; $1 \leq y \leq 10^5$);
3. "`? $l$ $r$`" — calculate the minimum penalty for passing the track consisting of platforms from $l$ to $r$ ($1 \leq l \leq r \leq n$).

## Output

For each query of the third type, output a single number on a separate line — the minimum penalty.

## Note

During the first query, the lengths of the course sections are $[4, 2, 5]$ with costs $[4, 2, 7]$; the optimal route is

$$1 \rightarrow 4 \rightarrow 6 \rightarrow 8 \rightarrow 11$$ In this case, the penalty is $4 + 0 + 0 + 7 = 11$.

Before the second query, the penalty of the second course increased, but we never get it; thus, the answer to this query is also $11$.

Before the third query, we have the lengths of the courses $[2, 2, 5]$; then the route $$1 \rightarrow 4 \rightarrow 6 \rightarrow 9$$ gives a penalty of 7, as the only penalizing jump is within one platform: $6 \rightarrow 9$.
statementZhMd:
**这是本题的简单版本。不同之处在于，本版本中 $x$ 的约束和时间限制更低。只有解决了本题的所有版本后才能进行 hack。**

海狸正在训练长距离跳跃。海狸已经可以跳跃 $x$ 米远了。然而，只跳到尽可能远的地方既简单又无聊。因此，海狸为跳跃训练设计了一条特殊的赛道。

赛道由 $n$ 个平台组成；每个平台由 $d_i$ 个长度为 1 米的格子组成。如果海狸站在编号为 $i$ 的平台上起跳，并且落回同一个平台上，则会被计 $s_i$ 分罚分；否则不会产生罚分。海狸每次可以向前跳跃任意个整数格子，跳跃距离不超过 $x$。注意，海狸一次跳跃可以跳过一个或多个平台，完全不在这些平台上着陆。

海狸拥有无限的计算能力，并且总是选择使通过整条赛道的总罚分最小的跳法。此外，赛道并非固定不变，有时某些平台的长度和罚分会发生变化。请计算：如果海狸从编号为 $l$ 的平台的第一个格子出发，并最终站在编号为 $r$ 的平台的最后一个格子上，那么它将获得多少罚分。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $n$、$q$、$x$，分别表示赛道的平台数量、查询数量和最大跳跃距离（$1 \leq n \leq 10^6$；$1 \leq q \leq 10^4$；$1 \leq x \leq 5$）。

第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $d_i$，表示各个平台的长度（$1 \leq d_i \leq 10^7$）。

第三行包含 $n$ 个整数 $s_i$，表示各个平台的罚分（$1 \leq s_i \leq 10^5$）。

接下来的 $q$ 行描述查询，每次查询的格式为以下三种之一：

1. `1 $i$ $v$` —— 将第 $i$ 个平台的长度修改为 $v$（$1 \leq i \leq n$；$1 \leq v \leq 10^7$）；
2. `2 $i$ $y$` —— 将第 $i$ 个平台的罚分修改为 $y$（$1 \leq i \leq n$；$1 \leq y \leq 10^5$）；
3. `? $l$ $r$` —— 计算通过由第 $l$ 至第 $r$ 个平台组成的赛道所需的最小罚分（$1 \leq l \leq r \leq n$）。

## 输出格式

对于每个第三种查询，单独一行输出一个整数，即通过赛道所需的最小罚分。

## 说明

第一次查询时，各赛道区段的长度为 $[4, 2, 5]$，罚分为 $[4, 2, 7]$；最优路线为

$$1 \rightarrow 4 \rightarrow 6 \rightarrow 8 \rightarrow 11$$

此时罚分为 $4 + 0 + 0 + 7 = 11$。

在第二次查询之前，第二个赛道区段的罚分增加了，但我们不会经过它；因此，这次查询的答案仍然是 $11$。

在第三次查询之前，各赛道区段的长度为 $[2, 2, 5]$；此时路线 $$1 \rightarrow 4 \rightarrow 6 \rightarrow 9$$ 的罚分为 $7$，因为唯一产生罚分的跳跃是在同一个平台内进行的：$6 \rightarrow 9$。
